name: Morxer electrical enclosures
old_description: Morxer is a leading provider of ready-made plastic electronics enclosures and electrical boxes for OEMs across a wide range of industries. Our enclosures are built from premium materials such as plastic, aluminum, steel, and stainless steel. Whether your application demands waterproof NEMA-rated enclosures or simple indoor potting boxes, our diverse product catalog offers solutions for various environments and uses. Prioritizing customer service and efficiency, we guarantee that stock orders placed before 3 PM EST Monday to Friday are shipped the same day. Customized orders, featuring CNC machining and digital printing, are delivered within 1-3 weeks. We continually innovate and expand our range of plastic and industrial metal enclosures, along with our value-added services, to ensure we meet the evolving needs of engineers and designers. With more than 2,300 variations of off-the-shelf metal and plastic enclosures, we are confident you’ll find the perfect fit. Our knowledgeable customer service team is always ready to assist, and our engineering experts can address even the most technical inquiries. Fast and reliable, working with Morxer is an effortless experience. With decades of expertise in the electronics industry, Morxer is your trusted partner now and for the future.
about:
Morxer Electrical Enclosures operates from Sheridan, Wyoming. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but describes itself as having decades of expertise in the electronics enclosure industry.

The company supplies ready-made and customized plastic and metal electronics enclosures for OEMs. Its catalog includes more than 2,300 off-the-shelf variations in materials such as ABS and polycarbonate plastics, aluminum, steel, stainless steel, and carbon steel. Value-added services include CNC machining, digital printing, color customization, custom labels, and laser printing. Stock orders placed before 3 PM EST ship the same day; modified enclosures are delivered in one to three weeks.

Morxer serves OEMs across a broad range of sectors. Its enclosures are used in outdoor power equipment such as extension cord covers, pool pumps, and landscape lighting; in residential electrical work for light fixtures, switches, and outlets; in industrial machinery for motor and equipment connections; and in marine, HVAC, security camera, and holiday lighting installations.

The company emphasizes a one-stop-shop model: no minimum order quantity, in-house engineering support, and global express shipping from domestic warehouses or directly from China. These factors, combined with same-day stock fulfillment, are presented as its primary differentiators.
